お願いが多めです.en: I have quite a few requests.

指す言葉があります.en: There is a word that refers to it.

就学援助.en: Financial help for families who have difficulty paying school expenses.

就学援助申請書.en: A form used to apply for financial help with school expenses.

入学準備費.en: Money needed to prepare school supplies before starting school.

転入学.en: Moving from another school to this school.

転校.en: Moving from the current school to another school.

編入学.en: Joining a school at a later grade or partway through a course.

在学証明書.en: A document showing that a child is enrolled at a school.

教科用図書給与証明書.en: A document listing textbooks provided by the school, used when transferring schools.

学区.en: An area used to determine a child's school based on where the child lives.

指定校変更.en: A procedure to change the assigned school to another school with permission.

就学時健康診断.en: A health check before a child starts elementary school.

健康調査票.en: A form informing the school about a child's health, including illnesses and allergies.

食物アレルギー.en: A reaction to certain foods. Please inform the school.

出席停止.en: Staying away from school as instructed, for example because of an infectious illness. It is recorded separately from ordinary absence.

口座振替依頼書.en: A form authorizing automatic payment of school fees from a bank account.

添付書類.en: Required documents submitted together with an application form.

認定結果.en: A decision stating whether an application for assistance has been approved.

通訳派遣.en: Arranging for an interpreter to come and help people communicate.

就学相談.en: Consultation about a child's schooling and the support the child needs.

学童保育.en: Care for elementary school children after school or at other times when their parents are away.

家庭訪問.en: A teacher visits a child's home to talk with the parents about the child.

PTA.en: A parent-teacher association that works together to support children and the school.

連絡アプリ.en: An app used to read school notices and contact the school.

欠席の確認.en: Your child has not arrived at school today. If your child will be absent or late, please contact the school.

遅刻して登校します.en: My child will arrive late today. I will tell you the expected arrival time later.

お弁当が必要です.en: There will be no school lunch tomorrow. Please have your child bring a lunch box.

持ち物のお知らせ.en: Please have your child bring a water bottle, towel, and writing tools tomorrow.

体操服が必要です.en: There will be physical education class tomorrow. Please have your child bring PE clothes.

提出物のお願い.en: The required document has not been submitted yet. Please have your child bring it to school by tomorrow.

行事のお知らせ.en: There will be a school event next week. Please check the handout for details.

面談の日程確認.en: Please confirm the schedule for the individual meeting. If the date is not convenient, please contact the school.

体調不良の連絡.en: Your child is not feeling well. Please contact the school as soon as possible.

けがの連絡.en: Your child was injured at school. We will explain the details by phone.

部活動の予定.en: There will be club activity today. Your child will leave school later than usual.

集金のお願い.en: We will collect money for learning materials. Please put it in the envelope and have your child bring it tomorrow.

アレルギー確認.en: We need to confirm something about school lunch allergies. Please contact the school.

授業参観のお知らせ.en: There will be a class observation this week. Please let the school know if you can attend.

宿題の確認.en: Please check at home whether your child has finished the homework.

連絡帳を見てください.en: I wrote an important message in the contact notebook. Please check it.

校外学習の持ち物.en: There will be a school trip for learning. Please have your child bring lunch, a water bottle, and rain gear.

保護者会のお知らせ.en: There will be a parents meeting next month. Please tell the school whether you can attend.

校則の確認.en: There is something we would like to confirm about school rules. Please check it together with your child.

入学の相談.en: I would like my child to enroll at this school.

手続きの窓口.en: Where can I complete the school enrollment procedures?

必要な書類の確認.en: Please tell me which documents are needed for the procedure.

書類の書き方.en: I do not know how to fill out the form. Could you go through it with me?

提出先の確認.en: Where should I submit this document?

提出期限の確認.en: What is the deadline for submitting this document?

転校の予定.en: My child will change schools because we are moving. Please tell me what procedures are needed.

転校の書類.en: Could you prepare the documents to give to my child's new school?

住所の変更.en: Our address has changed. Please tell me how to notify the school.

就学援助の相談.en: I would like to discuss school expenses. Can I apply for financial assistance?

援助の申請方法.en: Please explain how to apply for school financial assistance and which documents are needed.

費用の支払い相談.en: I am having difficulty paying the school expenses by the deadline and would like to discuss this.

口座振替の確認.en: Please explain how to set up automatic bank payments and when the money will be withdrawn.

通訳をお願いしたい.en: I find it difficult to understand explanations in Japanese. Could you arrange an interpreter?

やさしい説明のお願い.en: Please explain a little more slowly, using simple words.

面談の相談.en: I would like to meet with the teacher to discuss how my child is doing at school.

相談の予約.en: I would like to make an appointment for a consultation. Please tell me a convenient date and time.

食物アレルギーを伝える.en: My child has a food allergy. I would like to discuss school meals.

健康情報の確認.en: Please tell us about any ongoing illnesses, allergies, or other matters the school should be aware of.

登校再開の確認.en: When can my child return to school? Are any documents required?

学童保育の相談.en: I would like after-school care for my child. Please tell me how to apply.

買う物の確認.en: What should I buy for my child to use at school?

書類をもう一度ください.en: I lost the document from school. Could I have another copy?

連絡方法の確認.en: Should I contact the school by phone or through the app?
